## Anatomy

A `card` (`comp: 'ToolRow'`) that holds name, code id, description, state badges, an optional "Settings" link and the switch "Bật tắt <tên>".

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

**Composition.** One tool of the allow-list: name, code id, description, state badges, optional "Settings" link and the switch. The list of them is the `ToolAllowlist` of the recipe (WJ79-WJ86)
